scope: Authored application, shared, test, build/check scripts, styles, dependency declarations, and deployment configuration across the nine repositories. Generated outputs, vendored code, migrations, and historical design artifacts are excluded from comment rewriting.
method: Inspect module ownership, static imports and cycles, public exports, dependency declarations, long functions, unsafe boundaries, comments, and existing architecture maps.
Remove comments that repeat code or record obsolete implementations. Retain numerical, security, browser, and storage constraints.
Confirm comment-only edits preserve code/configuration, and run each repository verification gate plus relevant browser suites.
Keep cohesive renderers and state owners intact where splitting would add indirection without independent responsibility.
preservedDecisions: Each app keeps its own deployment and data ownership. Security hardening copies are intentionally independent.
Type-only Durable Object environment references are expected and do not form runtime initialization cycles.
mrrp keeps its cohesive canvas renderer and Durable Object state machine; the shared package owns only the wire contract and dependency-free constants.
No branches, pushes, deployment, production data changes, or new product features.
